blocks.text: The economic pages of Arabic newspapers have a fixed vocabulary and many numbers: growth, inflation, interest rates, budget, debt, exchange rate, foreign trade, business, stock exchange. In this unit learn to read and report an economic news with precision: indicators, the verbs of movement (to climb up, to descend, to stabilize), expressions of comparison over time (to be based annually on the same period as last year) the vocabulary of enterprises and trade, and the difference between a given and an interpretation. Countries, companies and figures of texts are invented. Four weeks, in parallel with EGY-12.
